_note: UrbIS download URLs were NOT checkable when this was written (datastore.brussels blocked). Fill 'url' from the dataset page on https://datastore.brussels (search 'UrbIS'), set 'verified' to the date checked, and record the licence in CREDITS.md. If a dataset is offered per municipality, take Uccle/Ukkel; if per map sheet, list several URLs. Files can also be dropped by hand into data/raw/urbis/<key>/ (zip or extracted).

buildings3d.title: UrbIS 3D Constructions (buildings LOD2)
buildings3d.expect: a vector format GDAL/OGR reads with 3D faces: CityGML/GML, 3D Shapefile (PolygonZ/MultiPatch), GeoPackage, DXF (3DFACE) or FileGDB. EPSG:31370 expected.

dtm.title: UrbIS digital terrain model (MNT/DTM)
dtm.expect: a raster rasterio reads (GeoTIFF, ASCII grid, XYZ). Heights in m TAW. Any CRS (reprojected to EPSG:31370).

transport.title: UrbIS transport network (street axes)
transport.expect: vector lines with street names. Used only to check names on the OSM graph (optional).
